description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and support our nursing team in a dynamic environment.As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and fostering a collaborative atmosphere. We are looking for a compassionate leader who is committed to clinical excellence and staff development.This position offers an attractive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000. While a Registered Nurse (RN) license is preferred, we encourage qualified candidates with strong leadership and clinical backgrounds to apply.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or leadership role.
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting.
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
